readout_other: fibre photometry of GCaMP7s calcium signals; elevated plus maze; tail suspension test; open field test; bulk RNA-seq of mPFC
direction_notes: aVNS increased calcium activity in mPFC, PirC, dHipp, BLA, vHIP, VTA and DRN; repeated aVNS improved anxiety-like and depressive-like behaviour in LPS and chronic restraint stress mice and partially reversed mPFC transcriptional changes.
safety_notes: Passive cavitation detection showed no detectable cavitation in water; focal-zone temperature rise stayed below 1 C during 15 min stimulation (4 mice); no histology of the nerve was done.

exposures.label: aVNS to left cervical vagus nerve

device.model: IBP0106 SF-1.75 in focused transducer with custom collimator

timing.protocol_description: 1 s sonication followed by a 9 s inter-stimulus interval; 15 min of aVNS in LPS mice; 7 consecutive days of aVNS in chronic restraint stress mice.
